import math

# Parameters
outer_diameter = 120
bore_diameter = 40
bolt_hole_diameter = 11
pcd = 95          # Pitch Circle Diameter
num_bolts = 6
thickness = 14

with BuildPart() as flange:
    # Main disc
    Cylinder(radius=outer_diameter / 2, height=thickness)
    
    # Central through bore (subtract)
    Cylinder(radius=bore_diameter / 2, height=thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    
    # Six bolt holes equally spaced on PCD
    pcd_radius = pcd / 2
    for i in range(num_bolts):
        angle = math.radians(i * 360 / num_bolts)
        x = pcd_radius * math.cos(angle)
        y = pcd_radius * math.sin(angle)
        with Locations((x, y, 0)):
            Cylinder(radius=bolt_hole_diameter / 2, height=thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

result = flange.part
